topics.label: Introduction to the complement lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing and introductory remarks for the lecture on complement.

topics.label: Foundations and central mechanics of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the fundamental architecture, naming conventions, and central role of component C3 in the complement system.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three upstream pathways that recognize pathogens and converge to generate surface-bound C3 convertases.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the downstream processes by which activated complement clears pathogens through opsonization, inflammation, and membrane lysis.

topics.label: Host regulation and protection against complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses how host cells utilize regulatory proteins to prevent unintended complement-mediated damage.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how deficiencies in specific complement components and regulators produce distinct clinical pathologies.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the molecular strategies pathogens employ to subvert and resist complement-mediated immunity.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the closing remarks and outlines the subject of the upcoming lecture.
